claims.evidence: Witness report shows a disassembled engine assembly with no visible branding, model markings, or origin documentation.
No paperwork, labels, or markings indicating Belgium are visible in the witness observations.
Witness report contains no running/test clip, no diagnostic readout, and no evidence of operation.
No audio/video of engine running is included in the witness observations.
No mileage/odometer/ECU readout is visible in the witness observations.
Witness report shows an engine assembly that appears disassembled; no seal/inspection evidence is provided.

risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete or missing key components (starter/alternator/sensors/ECU/hoses/brackets), since the assembly is disassembled and no completeness is shown.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo/clip showing every included part with a checklist, plus close-ups of connectors/sensors and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts-only and not guaranteed to be start-ready.

risks.risk: Condition/health is unknown (compression, internal wear, leaks, overheating history). The witness only saw external/internal components, not test results.
risks.proof: Compression test results (video/photo of gauge readings) and/or a diagnostic scan report from the ECU.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used engine with unknown health; treat as high risk for rebuild.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: without engine code/variant and mounting configuration, it may not fit the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine code/ID plate and casting numbers, plus the exact mounting bracket/bolt pattern shown against a reference.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified fitment; assume buyer may need additional parts/adapters.

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be false or unverified because no running evidence is provided.
risks.proof: Short running video showing stable idle and no abnormal noise, plus a temperature/OBD readout if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (as-is), with no performance guarantee.

risks.risk: “Never opened” conflicts with the disassembled appearance; seals/gaskets may have been disturbed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of factory seals/paint marks and gasket surfaces, showing whether they look untouched or recently replaced.

proof_requests: Provide clear photos of the engine code/ID plate and any model/casting markings (front/back/side) so the exact variant is identifiable.
Show a complete parts list with photos of every included component (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU/ECM if applicable, turbo/supercharger if applicable, all hoses/wiring, brackets/bolts).
Send a compression test photo/video (gauge readings) and/or ECU diagnostic scan report.
Provide a short running video (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no abnormal knocking, plus any OBD/temperature readout.
Show evidence of origin (any paperwork, shipping documents, or labels) if claiming Belgium tokunbo.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is an engine assembly, but key details needed to price safely (exact engine variant/compatibility and proof of working condition) are missing from the report. Without those, any price would be guesswork.
